SIGNIFICANT DISCOVERY: 19 of these 27 articles ALREADY carry a separate, pre-existing live-price mechanism — <span class="feature-price" data-amount="X" data-currency="EUR"> — read by apps/site/components/ArticleEnhancer.tsx to append a client-side live '(≈ $X today)' USD conversion. This is UNRELATED to lib/facts.ts's fact-span mechanism and was apparently built independently (matches the '5-features.md' live-money feature). Nesting a fact-span inside/around a feature-price span would let the two drift out of sync (the fact DB could update the visible EUR text while the USD conversion keeps computing off the now-stale data-amount attribute) — so the wrap script explicitly EXCLUDES any text node inside .feature-price, only spanning each value's OTHER plain-text repeat mention(s) elsewhere in the same article. Every one of the 52 new keys still got spanned successfully this way (each had at least one plain-text occurrence outside the feature-price widget) — nothing was dropped, but this is worth remembering for any FUTURE fact-span retrofit work on this site: always check for .feature-price before blind-wrapping a currency value.
